name: Daniel Garcia
source:
A tall macho boy who is bright and lively.
He can speak Japanese, though he is far from being fluent.
While he is from an emerging nation, his father is a wealthy company president.
He has always had an interest in Japan, and through an acquaintance of his father he was referred to [url=/c57898]the protagonist[/url]'s household.
His nickname is Danny.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc051/character.html#daniel]the official site[/url]]

---

Height in sequel: 195cm

He comes to Japan for the second time in search of a "woman willing to become his mother"
He is a friendly and cheerful person who gets along with people
He is always sure to do muscle training reps in order to maintain his muscles

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc061/character.html#daniel]the official site[/url]]
